name: Mentaro LMS
author: diamanto2011

sections.description:
Mentaro LMS is an easy-to-adopt learning management system built for clarity and speed. It avoids unnecessary complexity, stays reliable out of the box, and keeps your site responsive while you create and deliver courses.

Key benefits:
– Easy to understand and set up with minimal configuration.
– Streamlined workflow for creating courses and lessons quickly.
– Reliable out of the box with a clean, predictable UX.
– Lightweight footprint to keep your site fast.

Key features:
– Courses and lessons as custom post types.
– Lesson content uses the WordPress editor (text, images, embeds, audio/video).
– Assignments with optional stop-lesson gating and soft deadlines.
– Manual student enrollment per course.
– Instructor review: approve or request revision with comments.
– Student progress tracking and notifications.
– Custom login/registration pages and profile page via shortcodes.
– Design settings for typography, colors, and topbar.

External services

Mentaro LMS can optionally load Google Fonts when a Google Fonts URL is set in the design settings.

When enabled, your site will make requests to Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com).
Data that may be transmitted includes IP address and user agent.

Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mentaro-lms folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Open Mentaro LMS settings and assign pages with shortcodes:
    • [mentaro_login]
    • [mentaro_register]
    • [mentaro_courses]
    • [mentaro_progress]
    • [mentaro_notifications]
    • [mentaro_profile]
  4. Create courses and lessons, add assignments, and enroll students.
sections.faq:
How do students access a course?

Create a user account (or let students register), then enroll the student on the course edit screen.

Where do I review assignments?

Open the Submissions area in the admin menu to approve or request revision with a comment.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The LMS pages are shortcodes that can be placed in any page. You can also adjust colors, typography, and topbar in the plugin settings.
